segments.title: Lethal Company Co-Op Operation
segments.notes: Case Blackwell leads a chaotic Lethal Company session with guest crew, navigating scrap collection, monster encounters, and repeated fatalities across multiple moons.

segments.title: Broadcast Close & Schedule Announcements
segments.notes: Case outlines upcoming Patreon stream and improvised sketch comedy show with Tim, initiates raid on Gina's channel.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the Lethal Company co-op special, directing crew movements and managing terminal purchases amid escalating casualties.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: Makes brief on-mic appearance during the mission, demonstrating uncharacteristic bravery in the haunted facility.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Referenced as a dog (Pipita) in the studio, audible in background during equipment phase.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell commandeers the nightly broadcast for an extended Lethal Company operation, shepherding a revolving crew of guests through scrap runs on March and Dine that yield heavy casualties but meet quota. The broadcast closes with schedule notices for a Patreon stream and a late-night improvised sketch showcase.
